//: What release/build-release.sh puts into the template APK's assets/ besides the V8 snapshot.
preludes: classic runtime scripts in evaluation order (runtime/core config.preludes), each after the ones it
depends on, as the area READMEs state: glue first; dom right after glue (canvas2d and image attach to the
HTMLCanvasElement / HTMLElement / document it defines; a no-op in workers); net, storage and image after glue;
canvas2d after glue, net and image; webgl before xr; xr after glue and webgl; workers last. glue-subtle is
inert unless config subtle is 'digest'. NOT shipped (alpha scope): web/storage/dist/idb.min.js (IndexedDB +
workerPreludes: the subset worker globals evaluate (config workers.preludes; the default would be every page
prelude, but dom, storage, webgl, audio and xr do nothing in a worker: their natives are excluded there, and
skipping them halves worker boot, measured on a Quest 3S). Each must also be in preludes.
assetLists: per-module asset manifests ({from, to, compress}) copied verbatim (fonts + their licence texts).
